initiatives.name: Grain LNG Terminal Acquisition and Optimization
initiatives.summary: Signed a £20bn partnership deal with Equinor securing 5bn cubic metres of gas annually until 2035. This 10-year partnership with Norway helps maintain UK energy security and price stability.

evidence.title: Grain LNG terminal acquisition
evidence.summary: Acquired Europe's largest LNG regasification terminal in a 50/50 partnership with Energy Capital Partners for £1.5bn enterprise value. This enhances UK energy security by diversifying supply sources and providing stable contracted revenues.
evidence.quote: Our investment in Europe's largest LNG terminal – Grain LNG – with Energy Capital Partners is a further proof point of our strategy to pivot towards stable, predictable infrastructure returns.

evidence.title: Equinor long-term gas supply deal
evidence.summary: Signed a £20bn partnership deal with Equinor securing 5bn cubic metres of gas annually until 2035. This 10-year partnership with Norway helps maintain UK energy security and price stability.
evidence.quote: This is why we bought Grain LNG, why we want to redevelop Rough, and why we signed a £20bn deal with Equinor, securing 5bn cubic metres of gas a year until 2035.

initiatives.name: Energy Support Package Continuation (You Pay: We Pay)
initiatives.summary: Continuation of the UK and Ireland's largest voluntary energy sector initiative to support customers through energy crisis. The package includes innovative programs like 'You Pay: We Pay' matching customer payments for those in fuel poverty.

evidence.title: £140m energy support package continuation
evidence.summary: Continuation of the UK and Ireland's largest voluntary energy sector initiative to support customers through energy crisis. The package includes innovative programs like 'You Pay: We Pay' matching customer payments for those in fuel poverty.
evidence.quote: I'm proud of how we've supported those who need it most, especially through our £140m energy support package, which we launched in 2022, and is the UK and Ireland's largest voluntary energy sector initiative.

initiatives.name: Sizewell C Nuclear Power Station Investment
initiatives.summary: Centrica committed £1.3bn for a 15% equity stake in Sizewell C nuclear power station. This investment supports the delivery of reliable, zero carbon power generation and aligns with the UK's energy security objectives.

evidence.title: Sizewell C nuclear power station investment

evidence.quote: Putting £1.3bn into Sizewell C isn't just a great investment; it's about making sure the UK has reliable, low carbon power for years to come.

initiatives.name: Strategic Investment Acceleration Program
initiatives.summary: Deliberate acceleration of strategic investment to £1.2bn in 2025, representing one of the most active investment periods in recent years. This includes over £900m adjusted operating cash flow with planned £4bn total investment from 2023-2028.

evidence.title: Strategic investment acceleration program
evidence.summary: Deliberate acceleration of strategic investment to £1.2bn in 2025, representing one of the most active investment periods in recent years. This includes over £900m adjusted operating cash flow with planned £4bn total investment from 2023-2028.

initiatives.name: Board Succession and Strategic Leadership Appointments
initiatives.summary: Multiple board changes including new appointments of Alessandra Pasini and Frank Mastiaux, with planned departures of Heidi Mottram, Carol Arrowsmith, and Nathan Bostock. New committee chair appointments include Amber Rudd and Sue Whalley.

evidence.title: Board composition changes and succession
evidence.summary: Multiple board changes including new appointments of Alessandra Pasini and Frank Mastiaux, with planned departures of Heidi Mottram, Carol Arrowsmith, and Nathan Bostock. New committee chair appointments include Amber Rudd and Sue Whalley.
evidence.quote: I am delighted that Alessandra Pasini joined the Board this year; with a background in investment banking, Alessandra brings a wealth of international experience in renewable energy, battery storage solutions and green hydrogen. We also welcomed Frank Mastiaux, an energy industry veteran whose international leadership roles in some of the world's largest energy companies brings invaluable insight and experience to our team.
